risk_note: RV1 (contract text and generated comments only). 04 §11.1 gives user.lookup sight of a looked-up user's withdrawals; listAdminWithdrawals and getAdminWithdrawal accepted only withdraw.review / fund.view, so customer service got 10403 (CT-24y review S2). Now any of withdraw.review, fund.view, user.lookup. An account holding user.lookup but neither of the other two must pass user_id (else 10403 admin_permission_denied); on the detail, user_id of another user is 20001 [withdrawal_id] as an unknown id (the adminGetClaim precedent). For such an account reject_note and auto_decision are null, risk_flags is [] and holds[].source_ref is null (ruling D10-1042: BR-TEXT-08 internal note, BR-WDR-29 / 30 reviewer material), and passing risk_flag is 10403 since the filter would reveal the blanked flags. Those four fields were already nullable or arrays, so the response shape is unchanged; the detail gains one optional query parameter. No write operation gains user.lookup. Implementation is B2-09zg.
